# Independent audit of the all-template shape-aware shell obstruction

Audited source:
`candidate 2d5ed8c78661db43`.
Outcome: **PASS**, all six sections, with no mathematical correction needed.

The universal upper bounds beta(J)<=1/2 and kappa(J)<=1/2 follow from
complementary through-center caps and saturated opposite tails. The
shape-aware disjoint decomposition gives beta times own/residual weight
plus 2kappa times reflected weight, so at a three-fiber middle anchor the
exact-own version is exactly delta_K+2kappa V min(w_-,w_+). There is no
uncontrolled sign coefficient in this simplification. At an endpoint the
reflected credit vanishes and atomic isolation leaves just its own depth.

The coordinate-width bound applies to every convex template and every
translation: after reducing both endpoint radii to their minimum, the
body fits by translations into both boxes, and hence its coordinate widths
are bounded by their coordinatewise minimum. This does not assert overlap
of those two placed copies. The resulting common-copy volume is at most
t=(20/21)^100. Zero radii satisfy the same bound.

The exact binomial sum in Section 2 is 4209933/40000, as printed. The k
geometric comparison, exponential-series upper bound 87/32<11/4, and
Gamma_200>4/11 have the stated strictness. The pyramid apex sees precisely
the indicated box facet; its volume is epsilon=1/1000, and its nonzero
first moment makes the middle centroid graph nonaffine. Convex-hull
interpolation adds nothing outside K at integer base zero because the
endpoint midpoint is K_0 subset K. All three fibers and the ambient body
are full dimensional.

For every own point, complementary through-point halfspaces divide K_0
into masses summing to k, irrespective of whether the point lies in K_0.
Adding at most epsilon therefore proves delta_K<=k/2+epsilon. This is the
needed bound on the entire exact-own optimization, not just its centroid.
Consequently every menu value is below 1633/3000, while the original target
exceeds 6/11. Their difference is exactly 37/33000.

The independent actual good point is also valid: all three original box
centers are zero, so a through-(0,0) ambient cap captures k/2 from K_0 and
at least 1/2 from an endpoint with nonpositive continuous threshold. It
does not rely on global symmetry of the unequal-endpoint mixed set.
Pure integer caps capture still more, and shifting a containing cap to
its parallel through-point cap preserves the lower bound. The binary
padding argument isolates a chosen block by a finite exposing base
functional; reflected pairs remain in that block. Since the beta
coefficient is nonnegative, the upper bound for atomic depth is in the
correct direction. Original mass and 2^-n target scale exactly as stated.

Thus the source rigorously blocks the optimized SINGLE-template menu,
including shape constants and exact own-fiber depth, in every n>=1 with
d=200. It does not exclude multiple disjoint templates, original-fiber
remainder credits, or other actual center constructions.

Independent exact checker:
`supporting computation verify_all_template_shape_aware_obstruction_audit_two_sided.py`.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
